review.reason: The complete source candidate and both existing concept suggestions are supported by the pinned May and November captures. However, the authorized BNPL concept still gives readers several contradictory Klarna answers in its own Klarna Details section. A reader asking which countries offer Financing, whether setup_future_usage precludes recurring Klarna, which merchant countries can accept cross-border payments, or how partial refunds are allocated would receive the stale concept answer before following its source route. The concept definition also calls merchant payment immediate and in full without distinguishing accepted funds in Stripe from standard payout timing and fees. These are bounded concept corrections; the source candidate does not need a broad rereview.
